description: Make a shareable quote page for the customer, with no side effects: no order, no email, no payment link and no stock hold. Each blind is priced and stock-checked now; the page shows the lines and total and its button fills the customer's cart and opens checkout, where prices are checked again. Valid 7 days. Use this when the customer wants to review, share or pay later, instead of create_checkout.

items.description: Configured blinds; validate colours with configure_product first

colour.description: Exact available colour; validate with configure_product before adding

control_side.description: Chain or control side, as the customer faces the window. Defaults to right.

finish.description: Optional pricing finish for aluminium Venetians

mount_type.description: Use inside for inside mount or outside for face fix

no_drill.description: Optional. true for the no-drill option (tension brackets, inside the frame, max 2000mm wide; 1500mm on 25mm venetians). Adds the R65 no-drill kit per blind. Offered on indoor roller blinds, including value rollers, and 25mm aluminium or aluwood venetians. Dedicated no-drill products already include the kit.

product_id.description: product_id returned by search_catalog or lookup_catalog

product_name.description: Optional; server resolves the catalogue name

total_price_zar.description: Optional, ignored: server recalculates all totals

unit_price_zar.description: Optional, ignored: server recalculates all prices

name: create_quote_link
title: Create a shareable quote
